title: Item and NPC contracts
description: Items and NPCs, the things containment moves and holds (21 §8 Containment; 03 §23; 00 §4.4; 00a §5, §12), owned by containment (capability_registry.json). R5 slice 4: what take, drop and give need. Each is a RuntimeEntity: a fresh world gives it an EntityId (numeric profile, Initial world ids) and one container, the only place its location is stored (03 §23); a holder's contents and an actor's inventory are derived from it. Text follows the four LegendMUD tiers (owner decision 2026-09-25, Q1): keywords the player types, a short description for action messages and the inventory, a room line for the room's contents, and a description for examine. An item's equipment slot joins with equipment@1 (chapter-one slice c1-equipment); stacking, weight and put join with their capabilities as optional fields.

NameWords.description: Name words (loka-6qi): bare, the text key of the name with no article ("lantern"); optionally article, the article a presenter puts before bare (a, an or the); optionally plural, the text key of the plural ("lanterns"). short stays the phrase narration binds; words exist for presenters that compose a sentence from several names. Each key is in the text catalog.

bare.description: Text key of the name with no article.

article.description: The article a presenter puts before bare.

ItemLocation.description: Where an item starts (00a §12 location): in a room, held by an NPC, or inside another item of the same cartridge, named by the field its kind selects. The containers an artifact's items start in form no cycle (CONTAINMENT_CYCLE) and hold at most their capacity (CAPACITY_EXCEEDED).

oneOf.description: Starts inside another item of this cartridge.
Starts nowhere: it is a copy source only, and exists in play only once another rule makes a copy.

SlotKey.description: An equipment slot (equipment@1; 00 §4.4 and 21 §8 as amended by c1-equipment): the thirteen keys. A fresh world makes one holder entity inside the body per slot some item declares, capacity 2 for finger (two fingers, toolbox row 3) and 1 for every other slot (numeric profile, Slot holder ids).

ItemAffect.description: One attribute modifier an item grants its wearer while worn (docs/system/mechanics.md item slots and affects, toolbox row 3), or an active status grants its holder (StatusDefinition.modifies, row 2c; the shape of an ancestry's attribute modifier): attribute, an attribute of this cartridge; modifier, the signed amount added to the value attribute@1 reads. The number is the cartridge's.

ItemDefinition.description: A portable thing (21 §8): its key; keywords, the Alias words a player names it by (target resolution); name, the text key of its short description ("a brass lantern"); room_line, the text key of the line a room shows while it lies there ("A brass lantern sits here."), with room_line_variants (DescriptionVariant, first match wins, as for a room's description); description, the text key examine shows; location, where a fresh world puts it; and optionally container: true, making it a receptacle; only receptacles may declare capacity, the most items held directly (without capacity a receptacle has no limit); optionally slot, the SlotKey it is worn in (equipment@1), with optional affects (ItemAffect), each added to the wearer's attribute while the item is worn (toolbox row 3; needs slot and attribute@1); and optionally barrier, the barrier on it (a container's lid, barrier@1, c1-locks): a barrier of this cartridge that no exit and no other item names (BARRIER_MISMATCH), whose state the door verbs change with the item as target_id; while it is closed or locked, what the item holds is out of reach (containment@1 custody). Optional mass_grams is the shell mass, required for every item when world.carry is authored. Optional tags are its property tags (Tag, toolbox row G1). Optional name_variants and description_variants vary its name and description (TextVariants, toolbox row W6). Optional words are its name words (NameWords, loka-6qi).

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

name.description: Text key of its short description.

room_line.description: Text key of the line a room shows while it lies there.

room_line_variants.description: Room line variants; first match wins.

location.description: Where a fresh world puts it.

capacity.description: Most items held directly; receptacles only.

slot.description: The slot it is worn in.

equip.description: Authored wear and remove words (toolbox row 6a, loka-x6t.20): the Wear and Remove labels and the worn and removed lines. Only with slot; each key is in the text catalog.

worn.description: The line told when the item is worn.

removed.description: The line told when the item is removed.

identified.description: Toolbox row 27: a boolean fact, not per_subject; the item is identified while it reads true for the player, and GameView worn sums identified items only (needs affects).

intended_level.description: Balance tool 6b: the level the item is meant for, read only by the power report's gear budget (needs affects; the engine ignores it at runtime).

barrier.description: The barrier on it, a container lid.

mass_grams.description: The item shell mass in grams, excluding its contents. Required on every item under world.carry; explicit zero is valid (docs/system/cartridge.md Carrying settings and item mass).

give_allowed.description: API1.10: false prevents ordinary Give of this item or any container holding it transitively; absence permits Give when contents allow it. Dialogue hand_over remains legal.

container.description: Only explicitly authored receptacles hold items. Absence is false; capacity and barrier require this field.

block_chance.description: Percent chance that this shield blocks while held.

tags.description: Its property tags (Tag; toolbox row G1), read by the has_tag policy leaf (tag@1).

immune.description: Toolbox row G3: statuses that status.apply skips on this item's instance; each names a declared status.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this item: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

locks.description: Toolbox row G7 (mechanics.md Access locks): get, the policy an actor must hold to take this item or anything inside it, and put, the policy to put an item into it (a container only: compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION invalid_value at locks.put). Each is optional (absent holds) and read with this item as target; failing it refuses permission_denied.

Tag.description: A property tag (toolbox row G1): a closed engine vocabulary, so every mechanic that gives a tag meaning and every cartridge that declares one share its spelling. Item, barrier and room definitions declare tags; the has_tag policy leaf (tag@1) reads them. A row whose mechanic needs a new tag adds it here. A room tagged air, chasm or water (status reader 7) admits a move into it only for a body whose active statuses pass that tag. Toolbox row 28 gives cursed no meaning of its own (has_tag, wearing and resistances see it as any tag): content marks a curse-bearing item with it for a wearing leaf in that item's name variant. Toolbox row 43a adds road and marsh, which have no meaning of their own: cartridge.json world.movement.terrain gives a room tag a fare percent. Aimed spells (loka-x6t.109) add lamp, which has no meaning of its own: content marks a light an aimed lux may target.

DamageKind.description: A damage kind (toolbox row G2): a closed engine vocabulary shared by attack profiles and NPC resistances. A row that needs a new kind adds it here; a kind never shares a name with a Tag.

ResistancePercent.description: A resistance percent (toolbox row G2): negative is a weakness.

Resistances.description: Toolbox row G2 (docs/system/mechanics.md damage model): an NPC's percent resistance per damage kind (DamageKind) and per material tag (Tag) of the weapon whose own attack strikes (an unarmed or NPC attack has none); negative is a weakness. An attack sums the entries for its kind and each such tag, clamps the sum to -100..100 and scales its damage by (100 - sum) / 100, rounded down. Its members are exactly the DamageKind and Tag values.

NpcDefinition.description: A non-player character (00a §4), as a holder of items so far: its key, keywords, name, room_line and description as for an item, the room a fresh world puts it in, and optionally capacity, the most items it holds. Optionally daily_schedule, its daily location schedule (schedule@1), and schedule_cases, its conditional hours (toolbox row W10); dialogue joins with its capability as an optional field. Optional hp opts into entity-specific HP (docs/system/cartridge.md NPC HP overrides). Optional name_variants and description_variants vary its name and description, its mood (TextVariants, toolbox row W6); an NPC's room_line has no variants (owner, 2026-10-30). Optional words are its name words (NameWords, loka-6qi).

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

name.description: Text key of its short description.

room_line.description: Text key of the line a room shows.

room.description: The room a fresh world puts it in.

daily_schedule.description: schedule@1 (06 §13 Behavior/schedule profiles; 21 §10; capability_registry.json definitions): a daily location schedule. Each key is a nonnegative hour of the authored calendar day without a leading zero; the compiler checks it is below hours_per_day. From that hour until the next listed one (wrapping at day end) the NPC belongs in that room of this cartridge. A fresh world schedules one durable job at the first listed hour strictly after its start time; each job's run_job moves the NPC there, if it is elsewhere, and schedules the next (04 §5.4). Until its first job runs, the NPC stays in its room. An empty schedule schedules nothing.

disposition.description: Toolbox row G11: how the NPC stands toward the player, derived when read, never stored: hostile while hostile holds, else friendly while friendly holds, else wary (an NPC without it is wary). Each condition is read with the player as the actor and the NPC as the target, so subject target facts are its pair facts with the player. Hostile refuses talk and trade and, with an attack, engages a player who walks in, saying engage; friendly takes a friendly buy_discount. Toolbox row 35: with arrest instead of engage, a hostile NPC stops a player who walks in and the body goes to arrest.to, saying arrest.narration; no encounter opens.

engage.description: Said when this hostile NPC engages a player who walks in.

arrest.description: Instead of engage: this hostile NPC stops a player who walks in, and no encounter opens.

to.description: The room the arrested body goes to.

narration.description: Said when the player is arrested.

refuse.description: Book hostile refusal: the line the Book shows on the NPC's page while it is hostile, naming the mood, never the cause; projected as its EntityView refusal.

ask.description: Toolbox row FD7 (speech@1 with topic@1): what the NPC says when asked about a topic. The first answer in authored order whose topic is the one asked and whose when holds (the player as the actor, the NPC as the target) is narrated and grants its grants topic; none: unknown.

unknown.description: What the NPC says when no answer matches the topic.

answers.description: What the NPC answers, topic by topic.

topic.description: The topic this answer is for.

text.description: What the NPC says when asked about this topic.

grants.description: Granted when this answer is given.

schedule_cases.description: Toolbox row W10: conditional hours of daily_schedule. Each key is an hour daily_schedule lists (checked by the compiler); when that hour's job runs, the NPC goes to the room of the first case whose condition holds, else to the hour's daily_schedule room (the fallback). The source form is a daily_schedule hour mapped to [case, ..., room], which the compiler splits into the two fields.

resource_starts.description: Starting value of each named resource.

discovered.description: A fact that must be true for this NPC to be visible.

spawn_template.description: Not placed in a fresh world; used as a population template.

drops.description: Toolbox row 8 loot table (docs/system/mechanics.md loot tables, world.death): in order, an item this NPC holds at genesis and its percent chance of passing to the corpse when combat kills the NPC; a failed item stays with the dead NPC.

item.description: An item of this cartridge held by this NPC.

chance.description: Percent chance, 1 to 100, that the item stays on the corpse; otherwise it is kept back.

immune.description: Toolbox row G3: statuses that status.apply skips on this NPC's instance; each names a declared status.

attributes.description: Toolbox row G3: this NPC's base attribute values (attribute@1), read at use by an opposed check naming the NPC and by its derived attack; each names a distinct attribute of this cartridge. An attribute it does not list reads its definition start.

attribute.description: A cartridge attribute, read by opposed checks.

value.description: This NPC's value of the attribute.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this NPC: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

locks.description: Toolbox row 33 (mechanics.md Theft, fence and witnessed offense): get, the policy an actor must hold to take an item this NPC directly holds (target: that item); refuses permission_denied.

mount.description: Toolbox row 43b (needs world.mount): this NPC can be ridden. While world.mount.riding is true for (this NPC, a character) and both share a room, the character's moves need a destination room carrying one of terrain, each move's fare is scaled by cost_percent (default 100, floored, applied last) and this NPC moves with the body. Never on a spawn template.

terrain.description: Room tags this mount carries a rider over; a move into a room with none of them is refused. 1 to 8 unique tags.

cost_percent.description: Percent, 0 to 1000, applied last to the rider's move cost, rounded down. Absent: the cost is not scaled.

NameVariants.description: Toolbox row W6: variants of an item's or NPC's short name (TextVariants), each optionally with its own name words (NameWords), which a presenter uses while that variant names the entity; a variant without words has none, so a presenter shows its description alone.

description.description: Text key of the short name used while this variant applies.

TextVariants.description: Toolbox row W6: variants of one entity text (short, room_line or description), the first whose condition holds replacing it (DescriptionVariant, as for a room's description); the base text stays mandatory. Each condition reads with the entity itself as the target (status_active subject target).

ScheduleCases.description: Toolbox row W10: the cases of one conditional schedule hour, tried in order when the hour's job runs: the first whose when holds (an absent when holds; read with the player as the actor, the NPC as the target and the clock at the job's due time) names the room. A walks case moves only along a path (toolbox row W26). A case's optional goal is narration shown when the NPC leaves the player's room by that case.

walks.description: Toolbox row W26 (mechanics.md NPCs use doors): the step moves only when a path to room exists through exits a walking NPC may cross (breadth first, direction-key order, one query step per exit); the NPC moves in one step, each locked door on the path it holds the key of is unlocked, opened, closed and locked again; no path leaves it where it is.

chance.description: Percent chance an attack is accurate; a defense can still prevent the hit.

damage_max.description: Most positive damage; at least damage_min.

on_positive_hit.description: What a hit that takes off HP also does.

effect.description: The bleed applied to the player; used only when the attacker is spawned as a population hunter.

kind.description: The damage kind (cold, fire, physical or poison); the target's resistance to it reduces the damage.

crit.description: Toolbox row G2: a hit whose accuracy roll (the hit draw, uniform in [0, 100)) is below chance is critical and its damage is multiplied by multiplier, before resistances.

chance.description: Percent; a hit whose accuracy draw is below this is a critical hit.

multiplier.description: Damage of a critical hit is multiplied by this (2 to 10).

AttackProfile.description: Cartridge-owned hit chance and positive damage bounds. Compiler and loader enforce damage_min <= damage_max.

ShopOffer.description: One exact authored shop item definition with its positive buy and sell prices; custody determines availability (B3).

stock.description: Toolbox row W11: sell from this identity set, items[0] the offer's item, at buy[n-1] while the shopkeeper directly holds n of it; buy has one entry per item and buy[0] equals the offer's buy.

stolen.description: Toolbox row 34: this shopkeeper is a fence; sell takes only an instance whose world.theft stolen fact is true, and a shop without it only one whose fact is false. Never on a stock offer.

Shop.description: A finite NPC shop: conserved resource, exact authored item offers and committed purchase/sale narration keys (B3).

resource.description: The conserved resource prices are paid in.

bought.description: Text key of the purchase narration.

sold.description: Text key of the sale narration.

buy_discount.description: A buy price of floor(buy * numerator / denominator), at least minimum, while its condition holds: exactly one of skill (the actor has the skill usable) or (toolbox row 15) friendly, the shop's NPC disposed friendly to the actor (its disposition).

FuelRow.description: Exact-instance fuel history: bounded remaining charge, confirmed settlement time and stored ignition state. Supplies are never lit.

oneOf.description: A lightable item that burns fuel while lit, and is refilled from a supply item.

capacity.description: The most fuel the source holds, in its unit.

initial.description: Fuel it holds at the start; at most capacity.

rate.description: Fuel burned per logical time unit while lit; at least 1. It goes out when the fuel runs out.

unit.description: The fuel's unit name; the supply must use the same one.

supply.description: The supply item that refuels it; the supply's unit must match.

ignited.description: Text key of the line told when it is lit.

doused.description: Text key of the line told when it is put out.

refueled.description: Text key of the line told when it is refilled.

cues.description: Cues active only while this source is lit (toolbox row G6).

oneOf.description: An item that holds fuel for refilling sources; it is emptied by what it gives.

capacity.description: The most fuel the supply holds, in its unit.

initial.description: Fuel it holds at the start; at most capacity.

unit.description: The fuel's unit name; a source takes only a supply with the same one.

FuelSpec.description: Immutable authored source or supply metadata; sources bind one compatible supply and their narration keys.

ranged.description: Toolbox row 17: the weapon shoots in an encounter's round 1, spending one of the body's ammo resource pool; it never strikes in melee.

durability.description: Toolbox row 21: the bounded int entity fact holding this weapon's durability (its default is a new weapon's) and the amount each hit of its own attack takes off; at the fact's minimum it is broken and strikes unarmed.

WeaponProfile.description: An equipped weapon's required skill and authored attack profile.

ItemReadable.description: API1.24: one explicit held-item Read, with optional declared Boolean topic grant.

label.description: Text key of the read action's button.

text.description: Text key of what the player reads.

topic.description: A topic the reader learns on reading.

ItemEdible.description: D4 held-food metadata; a complete original item grants capped recovery when Eat commits.

resource.description: The pool eating restores (for example hp).

amount.description: Positive integer; the canonical numeric profile supplies the safe-integer upper limit.

label.description: Text key of the eat action's button.

narration.description: Text key of the line told when it is eaten.

cures.description: Statuses (toolbox row 1) this food ends when eaten; eating is allowed at the pool maximum while one of them is active.

applies.description: Toolbox row hs-5: statuses Eat applies to the eater's body after the recovery and any cures, through the shared status apply (status_applied on a first application, immune holds, a refresh is silent); none may modify an hp-maximum attribute.

ItemBandage.description: A directly held item opted into exact bleed treatment.

skill.description: The skill the actor must have usable to bandage.

action.description: Must be bandage: the key of the action that applies it.

narration.description: Text key of the line told when the bandage is applied.

Cue.description: A sense cue (toolbox row G6): what a listener smells, hears or feels from its source. sense is sound, smell or heat; text the authored line (the sense in its words, trap 12); range the rooms it carries through exits, 0 (the source's room only) to 2; when, optional, a condition read for the listener (the player for the view, a reaction's actor for an NPC). Owned by sense_cue@1. Its source is the room, detail, item or NPC, lit fuel source, active status or scripted action outcome that declares it.

range.description: Rooms it carries through exits, 0 to 2.

when.description: A condition read for the listener.

Cues.description: A source's sense cues (Cue; toolbox row G6), in authored order.
